title: Handoff record
description: One row in the handoff store (handoff.db). The filesystem YAML at file_path is the system of record; this is its queryable index entry. Emitted by `kaizen-handoff latest --json` / `list --json`.

session_id.description: The session/project grouping the handoff belongs to.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (millisecond precision) of the last save.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the canonical handoff YAML — the system of record. UNIQUE: re-saving the same file upserts this row.

content.description: Full YAML content, indexed at save time. Omitted from `list` output (metadata-only); present in `latest`/`get`.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the handoff's work.
